name: MCPToolBench++
description: MCPToolBench++ is a large-scale, multi-domain AI agent tool use benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' performance in calling Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. It includes datasets of single-step and multi-step tool calls from over 4,000 MCP servers across more than 40 categories, addressing challenges in tool integration and evaluation.
reputation: A new and specialized benchmark from the MCP ecosystem that is gaining attention in agent/tool-use evaluation, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Built on a marketplace of MCP servers; addresses diverse tool formats and context window limitations.
